reason: Primary Alsmeyer PDF obtained and visually verified. Experimental normalization and stated accuracy are established; primary M=3.8 curve digitization, digitization uncertainty, matched-condition comparison and numerical qualification remain incomplete.

secondary_sources.status: secondary_reproduction; dimensional coordinate conversion needs verification

exploratory_dimensional_comparison.method: Linear level crossings on secondary vector markers; solver collision mean free path scaled inversely with number density at fixed temperature and collision model. No fitted spatial rescaling.
limitations: Original experimental-to-metres conversion by secondary authors remains unverified.
Experimental and prior digitization uncertainty are not established.
Density similarity assumes dilute Boltzmann regime and matched remaining dimensionless parameters.
No experimental acceptance gate has been evaluated.
The two secondary reproductions differ in 10–90% width by 1.84% when the normalized reproduction uses the independently reported 1.098 mm scale. The earlier 1.65% MC3D difference is source-dependent.

normalization_evidence.title: A Modular Particle-Continuum Numerical Algorithm for Hypersonic Non-Equilibrium Flows
normalization_evidence.author: Thomas Edward Schwartzentruber
normalization_evidence.limitation: Secondary reference values agree with primary printed page 499; this does not validate secondary curve digitization.

secondary_source_consistency.method: Monotone regression of markers then linear 10%, 50%, 90% crossings; fixed supplied length scale. Translation removed only for centered crossing diagnostic.
limitations: Neither reproduction is primary experimental data.
Implied length from width ratio is diagnostic only, never an accepted fitted spatial scale.
Source discrepancy is not an experimental confidence interval or a justified acceptance tolerance.
Primary coordinate convention is verified; secondary reproduction and primary digitization uncertainty still require assessment.

verified_evidence.printed_page_500: Figure 1(b): measured argon profiles, M=3.8 dashed curve among overlapping Mach-number curves.
verified_evidence.printed_page_501: Figure 2 error bars show experimental scatter of at least three runs.
verified_evidence.printed_page_502: Figure 3: M=3.8 square markers denote Bird Monte Carlo; present experimental results are lines.

limitations: The stated accuracy bounds do not specify a Gaussian distribution or 95% confidence level.
300 K and 50 mTorr define the tabulated reference length; they are not a separately documented run record for the M=3.8 curve.
The density accuracy wording does not establish independent pointwise errors or their covariance.
Digitization error is additional and has not yet been quantified.
Corrections for electronics, curvature and downstream density rise are already included in published profiles; do not apply them twice.
Experimental reference mean free path and solver collision mean free path are different conventions; no spatial fitting is authorized.
